title.zh: 用两张照片核对同一个类别
title.en: Check One Class on Two Photos

brief.zh: 宇航员档案只收录模型找到的“人”。用同一个类别分别审查两张图。
brief.en: The astronaut archive takes detections of people. Check both photos for the same class.

concept.zh: 同一个类别筛选可以在不同图像上产生不同结果。
concept.en: The same class filter can produce different results on different images.

hints.zh: 核对有候选和没有候选的照片，看看哪一张符合档案要求。
hints.en: Compare the image that yields a candidate with the image that yields none.

prompt.zh: 仅查看“人”类候选，核对这张照片的返回数量。
prompt.en: Show only Person candidates and check how many this photo returns.

prompt.zh: 继续仅查看“人”类。保留正确的人物检测框。
prompt.en: Keep the Person filter and retain the correct box around the astronaut.
